notes: POS_SLEEPING is the minimum command position, so an awake actor reaches the handler and receives the exact daydream branch.
A sleeping actor receives the exact tulip dream line after the room act.
The C handler has no argument parameter; named, missing, and self-looking tails all take the same sleeping branch.
TO_ROOM emits the actor-substituted line to the awake peer while excluding the actor.
Plain TO_ROOM uses SENDOK with to_sleep false, so a sleeping peer receives no room line.
Focused MessageSink proof pins C's room-before-private actor emission order and exact CRLF bytes.
The C hide_invisible=TRUE argument suppresses the room line for an observer who cannot see the actor.
